title: Reconcile 8 diverged world-composition content pairs (not a mechanical move), then retire `data/content/world_compositions/`
summary: Consolidated world definitions to one authoritative location: data/worlds/<id>/world.yaml is now the sole definition of a world_id, with resolved/world.resolved.yaml as its generated projection, and data/content/world_compositions/ is deleted. The ADR states the law once (authority sentence plus the rule owner's source/projection clause); Bible 06 gains a sibling repository-layout law that is explicitly not a compile gate; content_authoring.md is corrected at four sites. A new architecture guard asserts one-world_id-one-module-set AND that re-resolving reproduces each committed snapshot, and it was observed RED on the untouched tree in its own commit. The resolver default flipped before the Campaign override dropped; ContentPathConfig.world_compositions_dir retired for DEFAULT_WORLDS_ROOT owned by the worldbuilding layer; the generator now authors the source definition with an injected catalog, a history-only typed provenance marker, refuse-to-overwrite, and resolve-before-commit. SUB-394 records the law; INFRA-184 updated. Full scoped regression AC left unchecked: two tests carry xfail(strict=True) tracking TCK-20261004-GENERATOR-AUTHORS-UNASSEMBLABLE-COMPOSITION-ON-REGION-ID-COLLISION, a pre-existing generator defect this work surfaced. Three defect tickets filed: that one, the inert-P1-balance-fix, and the dormant POSITION_SWAP contract.
